1. Handheld 365nm UV Torch & 3D World HUD

In WebXR VR, the machined 365nm UV torch locks ergonomically to the right controller. Sweeping it across the note reveals the authentic blue Agong watermark, glowing Hibiscus, and curved security fibres in real time while the floating 3D HUD tracks score, timer, and streak overhead.

VR · BACK UV & LIVE FEEDBACK Tap to zoom

2. Flip 180°, Laser Ray Buttons & Haptic Verdicts

Players flip banknotes with a single trigger pull or by aiming the laser pointer at the 3D floating PASS / TILT / FLIP / REJECT dock. Every hover scales smoothly with subtle controller haptics, and verdicts print instant forensic explanations directly onto the overhead 3D board.

Calibrated Right-Hand Torch Right grip grabs/drops the UV torch; right trigger toggles 365nm beam or clicks 3D buttons.
6-DOF Note Manipulation Left thumbstick smoothly rotates & tilts the note to test metallic holograms; right stick zooms up to 2.6×.
Zero Motion Sickness Stationary forensic lab workbench design keeps elderly and first-time VR visitors comfortable.
Bilingual 3D VR HUD 3D world-space HUD & floating action buttons auto-update in English or 中文 and stay hidden on laptops.

1. Crisp 3-Step Briefing & One-Click VR Launch

Walk-up players grasp the controls in 5 seconds: Tilt & Flip, Sweep the UV Torch, and Pass or Reject. Launches directly into Desktop/Touch mode or immersive WebXR VR from the same booth screen.

LAPTOP · FORENSIC WORKBENCH Tap to zoom

2. Unobstructed Forensic Lab Workbench

Desktop mode replaces the old floating VR box with a clean top HUD navbar and bottom control dock (UV, Tilt Hologram, Flip 180°, Zoom, PASS/REJECT + keyboard shortcuts) plus a built-in Note Guide drawer.

LAPTOP · 180% ZOOM BACK UV Tap to zoom

3. Drag-to-Sweep UV & 2.6× Forensic Zoom

Click-and-drag the UV torch anywhere across the front or flipped back of the banknote, or scroll/tap to zoom up to 260% to inspect fine serial digits, Kijang shields, and glowing thread segments.

COUNTERFEIT CAUGHT · RM10 Tap to zoom

4. Realistic Daylight & OBA-Paper Counterfeits

Real banknote cotton paper stays dark violet under UV — cheap counterfeit paper contains optical brighteners (OBAs) that glow flat chalky blue-white, paired here with a daylight Rafflesia swap and MALAYA typo.

LAPTOP · FORENSIC REPORT & REVIEW Tap to zoom

5. Instant Educational Forensic Report

Every round finishes with a full 10-note forensic breakdown showing what each player got right or missed — turning a 2-minute arcade challenge into memorable real-world anti-scam education that syncs directly to the Scamurai leaderboard.

Genuine UV Features

Engineered Counterfeit Tells

Multi-Layered Gameplay · Beyond Just UV

Three Real-World Forensic Checks

Players can't rely on a single shortcut — different counterfeits hide their flaws across daylight printing, 365nm UV light, and tilt angle.

Check 01 · Daylight

Motif, Logo & Serial Inspection

Real MYR scans edited with authentic daylight traps: BANK NEGARA MALAYA typos, swapped Rafflesia vs. Hibiscus, erased top-left BNM Kijang deer shields, mismatched vertical/horizontal serials, missing 2nd turtle on RM20, and opaque paper replacing RM5's clear polymer hornbill window.

Check 02 · 365nm UV Torch

BNM Fluorescence & Bleached-Note Traps

Matches real Bank Negara Malaysia UV chemistry: dark non-glowing cotton paper, blue Agong watermark numerals, crimson Hibiscus & neon Tengkolok star, two-colour back numerals, and 5-block vertical threads — plus chalky OBA fake paper and a bleached RM20 that glows RM 10 under UV.

Check 03 · Tilt Hologram

Angle-Reactive GLSL Security Strips

Custom WebGL shader aligns iridescent colour-shift strips and metallic threads to each denomination's real scan position. Tilting the note in VR or pressing Tilt on laptop exposes stealth counterfeits with dead, flat ink even when daylight and UV look real.

Quality & Event Deployment

Booth Readiness Summary

Ready for Event Day

  • ✓100% Offline-Capable: Zero external CDNs — local Three.js, local fonts, and all 42 banknote textures bundled cleanly (modular JS/CSS, no 68 MB monolith).
  • ✓Automated Test Suite Green: Station 1–5 unit tests + all 28 multi-player server pressure checks passing.
  • ✓Seamless Leaderboard & Survey Integration: Works inside the Scamurai booth wrapper with snapshot recovery and English canonical CSV exports.
  • ✓Full EN / 中文 Accessibility: Instant language switch syncs across desktop UI, Note Guide, VR 3D panels, and Forensic Report.

Optional Photo Upgrades

  • +Real 365nm UV Camera Photos: RM50 already uses real UV photos; RM5/RM10/RM20/RM100 currently use high-fidelity BNM-matched simulated UV layers and can drop in real camera shots anytime.
  • +Optional RM1 Polymer Note: Architecture supports adding RM1 (Wau Bulan) as a 6th denomination with zero layout changes.
  • +Quest Browser Check: Ready for a quick 5-minute physical Meta Quest headset run-through over HTTPS before event day.
